practicalCriteria: The complaint is logged with its date, channel and reference, and its wording is the customer's
Each fact the response relies on appears in the facts table with a source and the result of the check
The response describes the findings and does not attribute fault to the customer
The agreed outcome, follow-up with owner and date, escalation decision and closing review are recorded
passRule: assessor sign-off against rubric; no quiz pass
